dashboard.label: Run Performance
dashboard.description: Compare like runs by distance and terrain. Pace is distance-weighted. Best efforts are derived from continuous time-distance streams and include elapsed pause time. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
